evidence.snippet: A verifier that wants to correct its own reason at the same verdict cannot. It can only send a stronger verdict. Nothing is stronger than confirmed, so a confirmed lowering cannot be withdrawn by the verifier: a later confirmed report that holds the claim at the lens's severity is refused, and the claim stays one step down. Under the old rule that later report won, and the claim went back up. The maintainer accepted this cost on 2026-11-28, in the coordinator's session ("A, and read"), since the lowering still needs evidence at the head and passes the fence. A refused report is an error the verifier reads, and a verifier that never sends an accepted report leaves its claim unjudged, so the review reads not reviewed, as it does today for any claim the verifier skips.
- Use active verbs and name who did what. Passive voice only when the actor does not matter.

verification.reason: AGENTS.md line 19 says to use active verbs and name who did what, and to use passive voice only when the actor does not matter. The verifier's lost ability is the point of that sentence, so the actor matters, and it should be the subject. Line 12 is the same kind of problem. The finding is a style nit against a real written rule, and the file's own active sentences show the rule can be met.
